edits.text: 2. COMPENSATION. The Executive shall receive an annual base salary of $400,000 (the “Base Salary”), payable in accordance with the Company’s regular payroll practices and subject to applicable withholding. The Executive shall be eligible to participate in employee benefit plans made available to similarly situated executives, subject to the applicable plan terms.
edits.name: Compensation

edits.text:
3. SEVERANCE. If the Company terminates the Executive’s employment without Cause or the Executive resigns for Good Reason, the Company shall pay severance equal to 24 months of the Executive’s Base Salary in effect immediately before termination, disregarding any reduction giving rise to Good Reason. Severance shall be paid in equal installments over 24 months in accordance with regular payroll practices, subject to applicable withholding and mandatory law. For that period, the Company shall also provide continued health coverage for the Executive and eligible dependents on substantially the same terms, including the employee contribution, as immediately before termination. Such coverage shall be provided through available continuation coverage and, when that coverage is unavailable, through substantially equivalent coverage or reimbursement of its reasonable cost, to the extent permitted by law. Accrued unpaid salary, reimbursable business expenses, and vested benefits shall be paid separately in accordance with applicable law and plan terms.
“Cause” means (i) conviction of, or a plea of guilty or no contest to, a felony involving fraud or dishonesty; (ii) fraud, embezzlement, or willful misconduct in performing the Executive’s duties that causes material harm to the Company; or (iii) a material breach of this Agreement or willful and continued failure to perform material duties, other than because of incapacity, that remains uncured for 30 days after written notice specifying the breach or failure. Before termination for Cause, the Company shall provide written particulars and a reasonable opportunity for the Executive to respond.
“Good Reason” means, without the Executive’s written consent, (i) a material reduction in Base Salary; (ii) a material diminution in authority, duties, or responsibilities; (iii) relocation of the Executive’s principal workplace by more than 50 miles that materially increases the Executive’s commute; or (iv) the Company’s material breach of this Agreement. The Executive must give written notice within 90 days after becoming aware of the condition, allow the Company 30 days to cure, and resign within 60 days after expiration of that cure period if the condition remains uncured.
edits.name: Severance and termination definitions

edits.text: 4. NON-COMPETE. No post-employment non-compete restriction is imposed by this Agreement. Any proposed narrower restriction must be separately negotiated, supported by separately agreed consideration, and reviewed for compliance with governing law.
edits.name: Deletion of blanket non-compete
